findings.summary:
Fix any of the following:
  Element has insufficient color contrast of 3.75 (foreground color: #ffffff, background color: #d4622f, font size: 12.0pt (16px), font weight: normal). Expected contrast ratio of 4.5:1
findings.note: The 'Book online' button has insufficient color contrast (3.75:1) between its white text and red background, making it hard to see for users with low vision or color blindness. It affects people with visual impairments and those using screen readers or high-contrast modes.
findings.suggested_fix: Change the background color to one with better contrast, such as #d4622f (current) → #d43f3f (red), or use a more visible color like #005a9e (blue). The contrast ratio of #ffffff against #d43f3f is 4.6:1, which meets WCAG 2.2 AA requirements. Alternatively, increase font size to 14px (16px is already 16px, so this is not needed).

findings.summary:
Fix any of the following:
  The link has insufficient color contrast of 1.47:1 with the surrounding text. (Minimum contrast is 3:1, link text: #ffffff, surrounding text: #cfd6d9)
  The link has no styling (such as underline) to distinguish it from the surrounding text
findings.note: The 'Privacy policy' link has poor contrast (1.47:1) with surrounding text and lacks visual distinction like an underline or different font style, making it indistinguishable for users with low vision or cognitive disabilities.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an underline or a different font style (e.g., bold) to distinguish the link. For example, style it with a solid underline using CSS: 'text-decoration: underline;'. Ensure the text color is at least 3:1 contrast with surrounding text. Use a color like #005a9e (contrast ratio 4.4:1 with #cfd6d or #cfd6d9).

Therefore, it fails.
